verified_facts.text: The hotel is built into the cliffside, surrounded by Mediterranean gardens and a series of terraces leading down to beach level.
verified_facts.excerpt: is built into the cliffside surrounded by Mediterranean gardens and a series of terraces leading down to beach level

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from the port and center of Amalfi every day of the week.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from the port and center of Amalfi every day of the week.

verified_facts.text: Guests can book a private boat transfer directly to the hotel's jetty from Naples and other towns along the Amalfi Coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can book a private boat transfer directly to the hotel

verified_facts.text: Naples Capodichino International Airport is the closest airport, approximately a 90 minute journey from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Naples Capodichino International Airport is the closest to Amalfi, approximately a 90 minute journey from Hotel Santa Caterina

verified_facts.text: The beach club has easy access to the sea and a salt water swimming pool, with sun beds, umbrellas, beach towels, and changing and shower areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: With easy access to the sea and a salt water swimming pool, the beach club service includes sun beds, umbrellas, beach towels, changing and shower areas

verified_facts.text: The beach club is open from mid-April to October.
verified_facts.excerpt: OPENED FROM MID-APRIL TO OCTOBER

verified_facts.text: The beach club deck, including the pool, is not fully accessible, but access is possible with the assistance of staff.
verified_facts.excerpt: The deck is not fully accessible (including the pool), however access is made possible with the assistance of our staff.

verified_facts.text: At the beach club, guests can have a cocktail at the Beach Bar and a Mediterranean style lunch at Al Mare Restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Between a cocktail at the Beach Bar and a Mediterranean style lunch at Al Mare Restaurant

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have hand painted majolica floors, marble bathrooms and balconies with sea and garden views.
verified_facts.excerpt: all the rooms and suites at Hotel Santa Caterina are spacious and bright, with hand painted majolica floors, marble bathrooms and balconies with wonderful sea and garden views

verified_facts.text: Glicine serves modern interpretations of classic Amalfi cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Modern interpretations of classic Amalfi cuisine ensure Glicine is deservedly well-placed

verified_facts.text: Casa Marchesa is a historic residence surrounded by Sfusato Amalfitano lemon groves, with a view of the Mediterranean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: this historic residence has a breathtaking view of the Mediterranean Sea and is surrounded by fragrant Sfusato Amalfitano lemon groves

verified_facts.text: The hotel received its first guests in 1904, after Dr. Giuseppe Gambardella and his family turned their house into a small inn.
verified_facts.excerpt: It received its first guests in 1904 after Dr. Giuseppe Gambardella and his family decided to transform their house into a small inn with only six guestrooms.

verified_facts.text: Giusi and Ninni Gambardella, with their children Crescenzo Gargano and Alessandro and Beatrice Camera, directly manage the hotel's day-to-day operations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Giusi and Ninni Gambardella, assisted by their children Crescenzo Gargano and Alessandro and Beatrice Camera, directly manage the day-to- day operations of the hotel

verified_facts.text: The Romeo e Giulietta suite is a two-story villa on the cliff above the sea, with a terrace that has a heated infinity pool and solarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perhaps the most special suite is the Romeo e Giulietta, an intimate two-story villa perched high on the cliff above the sea with a terrace equipped with a heated infinity pool and solarium.

verified_facts.text: An elevator descends along the cliff, with a window looking out over the panoramic view.
verified_facts.excerpt: The elevator takes you down rather than up, descending along the cliff while you take in the panoramic view through its window

verified_facts.text: The spa's signature treatment is Oro di Amalfi, a massage with natural lemon oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: the standout one is Oro di Amalfi, an exclusive massage with natural lemon oils

verified_facts.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and windows with views of the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: A gym with Technogym equipment and windows with views of the sea completes the experience.

verified_facts.text: Bath amenities are from Bvlgari's white tea collection.

verified_facts.excerpt: Couples, families with children, and solo travelers, as in our case, are welcome.
